brief_rationale: The trajectory meets all responsibility-chain requirements with no serious or minor errors. All five dimensions are at least good. HO2 (privacy navigation) is complete through respectful, persistent questioning that obtained safety-critical medication and BP information despite patient reluctance. HO1 (timeline reconstruction) is not completed—the doctor failed to explicitly build or explain a phased timeline from the fragmented records, only noting the patient was hospitalized post-PCI. With one high-order point complete and no quality defects, the grade is Strong.

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO1 requires explicit timeline reconstruction distinguishing consultation, transfer, PCI, and uncertain follow-up phases. The doctor confirmed hospitalization and PCI status but never explained or mapped the phased timeline to the family.

citations.explanation: Doctor attempts to obtain medication names and doses despite family not having the information
citations.quote: 请务必让护士核对药物名称和剂量，避免误服或漏服

citations.explanation: Doctor acknowledges medication uncertainty and provides clear boundary against self-adjustment while directing verification
citations.quote: 支架术后必须长期服用抗血小板药物，这是防止支架内血栓的关键

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO2 is complete: the doctor navigated privacy/information barriers by persistently explaining safety rationale for each data item, directing practical verification methods (nurse station, medication bottles, discharge paperwork), and documenting remaining unknowns with concrete resolution steps.

HO3 requires verification of a specific ambiguous family interpretation. The family provided specific test interpretations (elevated troponin, BNP suggesting cardiac burden) from the physician rounds, not ambiguous fragments needing verification by the tested doctor.
HO4 requires dynamic reprioritization when new urgent information emerges. No new symptoms emerged that changed urgency; the patient remained stable throughout with unchanged plan.

important_non_chain_defect_assessment.explanation: No important non-chain quality defects identified. All responsibility-chain items met, dimensions at least good, and one high-order point completed.
